shadowSentences: I love reading books at night.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
I usually bike to school every day.
Cooking new recipes is my weekend activity.
Traveling to different countries is exciting for me.
I often volunteer at the local animal shelter.
Listening to music helps me relax after classes.
Hiking in the mountains is a great way to exercise.
I enjoy watching documentaries to learn new things.
Exploring new cuisines is one of my passions.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What are some challenges you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How do you feel about traveling alone versus with others?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about effective study strategies.
questions: Q1: What study methods have you found most effective for you?
Q2: How do distractions affect your study sessions?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the importance of study breaks?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone struggling with their studies?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in maintaining a regular workout routine?
Q3: Why do you think physical fitness is important for overall well-being?
Q4: What recommendations would you make for someone new to exercising?
